entities.name: Q42613
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Brassica juncea S-adenosylmethionine decarboxylase proenzyme 1.
Annotated EC 4.1.1.50; catalyzes decarboxylation of S-adenosyl-L-methionine to S-adenosyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propylamine and CO2.
Uses one covalently bound pyruvoyl group per subunit as cofactor.

entities.name: RHEA:15981
observations: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H+ → S-adenosyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propylamine + CO2; catalyzed by S-adenosylmethionine decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.50).
